assumptions.assembling_machine_assignment: Character (speed 1) may cover basic crafting only; AM1 (speed 0.5) covers remaining basic and all advanced-crafting; AM2 (speed 0.75) covers all crafting-with-fluid; AM3 is not used. This relies on the player assumption that AM2 is more expensive to make than 1.5 AM1s.
assumptions.energy_and_mining_infrastructure: Not lower-bounded here; this exporter only closes crafting/research machine demand.
assumptions.generic_recipe_rule: Reverse-propagate only when the required material has exactly one single-output recipe producer.
assumptions.lab_speed_bonuses: Ignored; lab speed is fixed to 1 for this assumption set.
assumptions.oil_rule: Basic oil processing covers the petroleum needed for the 75 chemical science packs in the advanced-oil-processing cone. Remaining petroleum is lower-bounded using advanced oil processing with free complete cracking; light/heavy bounds are also checked and the maximum is used.
assumptions.other_machine_speeds: Chemical plants, oil refineries, stone furnaces, rocket silo, and labs are treated at speed 1, with their category workloads assigned uniquely.
assumptions.productivity_modules: Only the rocket silo receives the productivity-3 benefit, represented directly by 72 rocket-part crafts. Module research/crafting cost is not charged.
assumptions.solid_fuel: All required solid fuel is made from light oil.
assumptions.speed_modules: None; all machine speeds below are base speeds.

feasibility_objective.note: v31 direct mode: solve the original feasibility LP directly with zero objective. This avoids the dense shared Phase-I slack column, which was observed to produce order-dependent false positive minima.

goal_pruning.technology_scope: mandatory unique unlock of named goal recipe plus ancestors

infeasibility_certificate.note: In direct mode, v31 uses highspy as the primary backend when available, so an infeasible status and dual ray come from the same HiGHS instance/version. If SciPy is explicitly selected or highspy is unavailable, v31 falls back to a checked highspy re-solve. In either case it undoes explicit row scaling and verifies the aggregate contradiction against the original unscaled LP using extended-precision arithmetic. A verified ray is sufficient by itself; randomized confirmations are fallback only.

lower_bound_test.interpretation: The feasibility LP did not return a decisive feasible/infeasible answer; no lower-bound claim is made.

lp_scaling.column_scaling_strategy: semantic action-aware q scaling + row equilibration

semantic_action_scaling.or_to_or_source_unit_normalization: For simple synthetic OR->OR rows with one negative source coefficient -a and one positive output coefficient, use D=1/a so q is measured in source-material units.
semantic_action_scaling.semantic_scaling_formula: Base D_r=sqrt(median_positive_effect / physical_effect_r), clipped to [1e-3,1e3]; simple synthetic OR->OR conversions override with D_r=1/source_amount; original q=D_r*solver q

matrix_orientation: S is AND/action rows x OR/material columns

ordering_search.note: Permuting rows/columns does not change the LP; it changes only the simplex/presolve path. Feasibility mode is solving the original zero-objective LP directly. Any validated feasible solution overrides uncertified infeasible/positive-Phase-I reports from other orderings. A highspy dual ray that is independently verified against the original LP stops immediately as a Farkas proof. The O(nnz) variable-bound row precheck runs first and can prove infeasibility without HiGHS.

signed_amount_convention: AND->OR positive output; OR->AND negative consumption
solver_message: No validated feasible solution found, but only 0 ordering(s) gave infeasible status (required 1); treating result as numerical difficulty.

technology_relaxation.interpretation: Only the mandatory goal technology and its recursive prerequisite cone are modeled. Those technologies are forced to be fully researched (q0=1), so their direct science costs are paid exactly once. Optional technologies are left free/ungated, which is an optimistic relaxation and preserves lower-bound validity. Every uniquely technology-gated recipe in the mandatory cone with a finite derived real-time rate bound is constrained by technology-availability moments; fixed required copies retain their stronger known-mass timing constraints.

recipe_rate_upper_bound_derivation.method: static carrier-flow LP; recipe-category and entity-operate-output coordinates balanced, ordinary ingredients/energy free; each finite entity capacity <= initial + placement_rate*delta
